summary: TEPFI → Capabilities & Resources Index rename + per-cell overrides verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass — dashboard enrichment (auto/score/overridden/note), PUT/DELETE overrides, all-vs-life-area scope isolation, per-user permission boundary, 400 on empty cell_key + non-numeric score, /tepfi/entries CRUD regression, /tepfi/metadata returns the 8 effort sub-dimensions. Frontend: /tools/tepfi header reads 'Capabilities & Resources Index' (NOT old name); matrix title 'Avg Scores · Overall Life' renders and flips to 'Avg Scores · Career' on chip tap; all 10 life-area chips + 'All' visible in 2 rows on 1280×800 (no horizontal scroll); tapping testID avg-cell-time-self opens the modal with 'Your value: N/10 · M%' + 'Computed avg from assessments: N/10 · M%' lines; override-save-btn click adds the OVR pill (override-pill-time-self appears); re-tap shows override-reset-btn which clears the pill. /tools/tepfi-entry header reads 'New Capabilities Assessment'; chips wrap; Effort row expands into all 8 sub-aspects (Attitude/Knowledge/Skills/Physical Health/Mental State/Emotional Wellness/Energy Level/Action) and the 'N/10 · M%' score labels render (24 occurrences captured). Code review verified the rename hit all 7 files listed in the spec. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Both tepfi.tsx and tepfi-entry.tsx remap CATALOG_LIFE_AREAS using `a.short` for the local `name` field (line 34 / line 43). That keeps chips compact (Health/Knowledge/Career/Social Image…) so all 10 fit in 2 rows. Effective behavior matches the spec which asked for 'all 10 visible at first glance on phones' — confirmed visually.
Backend override scoping (ctt_gem.py:788-826) cleanly separates scope='all' from scope='<life_area>' via the {user_id, scope, cell_key} composite key; no bleed-through observed in test 1c.
DELETE /tepfi/overrides/{scope}/{cell_key} is idempotent — returns {ok:true, deleted:0} when nothing matched; current tests assert deleted==1 only for the seeded case.
Validation order: cell_key check happens BEFORE score float() — empty cell_key + non-numeric score both return 400 with clear detail.
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped TEPFI entry titled 'TEST_TEPFI_overrides' (life_area=career) created+deleted via fixture. Override rows cleaned via autouse fixture before/after each test on cell_keys [effort_self, effort_micro, time_self, people_macro] for scopes [all, career]. mongosh-free, no leftover rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend auth on the preview URL was bypassed for this test by minting a token via local backend (POST http://localhost:8001/api/auth/login admin@test.com / AdminPass2026!) and injecting it into window.localStorage.setItem('session_token', '<tok>') before navigation — same JWT works against both ingress (preview) and 8001 since they share the DB. The on-page Sign In flow was flaky due to a transient 'getRehydratedState' rehydration error (storybook persist), but it did NOT block the test path. If future tests need a real-login flow, retry the Sign In click after a 4-5s settle. TestIDs verified live: avg-cell-<dim>-<layer>, override-pill-<dim>-<layer>, override-save-btn, override-reset-btn. The OVR pill renders only when cell.overridden===true after dashboard refetch — confirm by checking pill count post-Save.
